# Needpedia Nexus

Public document collection for Needpedia, an open-source nonprofit civic
collaboration platform (needpedia.org). Everything listed here is a plain
public page and may be fetched directly.

Rebuilt 2026-09-29

## Start here
https://nexus.needpedia.org/start.html
  Front door: what Needpedia is, how to get involved, contact addresses.

## Collections
https://nexus.needpedia.org/articles/index.html
  Long-form articles, core facts, glossary, use cases, episodes (13 documents).
https://nexus.needpedia.org/articles/index.txt
  Same listing, plain text.

https://nexus.needpedia.org/botskills/index.html
  Behaviour guides for the Needpedia AI assistants (14 documents).
https://nexus.needpedia.org/botskills/index.txt
  Same listing, plain text.

## Working with Tony, and the thread system
https://nexus.needpedia.org/working-with-tony.html
  How any AI works with Tony Brasher, Needpedia's founder, and where every
  project thread keeps its prompt accomplice and its public updates posts.

## Nonprofit records (public by intent)
https://nexus.needpedia.org/Articles/Nonprofit%20Documents%20for%20Needpedia/
  Articles of incorporation, bylaws, board members, conflict-of-interest policy.
